# Roars Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

> Roars Technologies is a product design and development company, founded in 2005. 4,000+ products shipped, 2,500+ clients, 63% of current work AI-driven. Offices in Bengaluru, India; Frisco, USA; London, UK; Heist op den Berg, Belgium; München, Germany.

Contact: sales@roarsinc.com
Book a call: https://meet.roarsinc.com/sales
Phone: +1 (302) 505-1200 (US), +44 (7537) 183399 (UK)

## Free resources

- [Building Partnerships](https://www.roarsinc.com/resources/building-partnerships/): Many complex problems have related causes and effects.
- [Business Model Canvas](https://www.roarsinc.com/resources/business-model-canvas/): A one page overview of both what you do and how you go about doing it, laying out the crucial activities and challenges and how they relate to each other.
- [Business Plan](https://www.roarsinc.com/resources/business-plan/): A structured description of how you do what you do, articulating the problem the business proposes to solve and a vision for how that will be accomplished.
- [Evidence Planning](https://www.roarsinc.com/resources/evidence-planning/): A quick way to articulate and improve what you are trying to accomplish, and an easy way to define and share it with everyone who has to act on it.
- [Innovation Flowchart](https://www.roarsinc.com/resources/innovation-flowchart/): How an idea travels from the day somebody has it to the day it is funded, shelved or killed, and who decides at each turn.
- [Learning Loop](https://www.roarsinc.com/resources/learning-loop/): Define how the work you do now informs what you do next, and how implementing change breaks down into iterative cycles you can actually run.
- [People & Connection Map](https://www.roarsinc.com/resources/people-connection-map/): Who has to say yes, who can say no, and who nobody has spoken to yet.
- [Pitching Checklist](https://www.roarsinc.com/resources/pitching-checklist/): What has to be in the room before you pitch and what has to be out of it.
- [Problem Definition](https://www.roarsinc.com/resources/problem-definition/): Write the problem down before anybody proposes a solution.
- [Product Solution Benefit](https://www.roarsinc.com/resources/product-solution-benefit/): Storyboarding that helps you find customer pain points and work out which solution actually answers them, before anyone writes a line of code.
- [Prototype Testing Plan](https://www.roarsinc.com/resources/prototype-testing-plan/): Idea, try, test, specify. Prototyping is more than trying things out: it is a structured way to check you have an efficient and fitting solution.
- [SWOT Analysis](https://www.roarsinc.com/resources/swot-analysis/): Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities and Threats on one page.
- [Target Group](https://www.roarsinc.com/resources/target-group/): Best used when you are working out initial ideas about who you want to cater to and why, before the audience hardens into an assumption nobody revisits.
- [Value Proposition](https://www.roarsinc.com/resources/value-proposition/): Identify your customer's major jobs to be done, the pains they face trying to accomplish them, and the gains they perceive by getting those jobs done.
- [Web Redesign ROI Calculator](https://www.roarsinc.com/resources/website-redesign-roi-calculator/): Work out what a redesign would have to change in order to pay for itself, and decide whether that change is plausible, before the project is approved.
